summary: A tense, economical beat with a clear turn: Shalabi imposes discipline, Mostafa nearly breaks it, and Sayed physically and verbally brings him back. The exchange is natural, character-specific and tactically credible.
scene_issues: The whispered exchange will only read over the tank noise if Sayed and Mostafa are blocked nearly mouth-to-ear; keep the physical contact prominent.

performance.delivery: Speak directly into the handset, clipped and firm despite the low volume. The second order must close off any room for individual initiative.
Keep hold of Mostafa’s hand and deliver the words close to him through the track noise. Let the pause carry the warning; do not sound excited.

lines.speaker: MOSTAFA

performance.delivery: Keep the RPG sight fixed and force the line through clenched teeth. Use a weighted adult chest voice under strain, not a frightened boy’s tremble.

lines.text: دِي فِي وِشِّي يَا عَمّْ سَيِّدْ!

lines.speaker: SAYED

performance.delivery: Answer Mostafa’s panic without looking away from the tank. Land the first sentence as a hard correction, then make the second a quiet order.

lines.text: وِإِنْتَ مِشْ فِي وِشَّهَا. سِيبْهَا تِعَدِّي.
